verdict.rationale: Docs describe Guardrails that determine what Lindy can do without asking (lindy-docs-8, lindy-docs-24) and email drafts that wait for user approval before sending (lindy-docs-31), implying some human-in-the-loop gating, but there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'pause workflow and wait for approval/input' step that halts and resumes a routine/workflow. Missing for 10: explicit workflow-level approval/pause node, description of resuming execution after human input, and any hands-on or independent confirmation of this exact mechanic.
